objective: Proof-mode replay of BOUNDED-H1-20261025-001A by a separately written code path in the same session (V1 independence, not external review). Rebuild the alternating diagrams of plane graphs with a port-and-corner construction; check that each diagram alternates, has 1 + dim B(G) components and determinant equal to the spanning-tree count of G. Count S4 transposition colourings by brute force from the Wirtinger presentations and compare with the bicycle law computed by a fresh bicycle-space routine; check the Potts(12, 1/2) identity on subdivided graphs (links), the knot condition and end-to-end counts on gadget knots, and the interpolation algebra that recovers P(H, 12). Audit the written proof for gaps. Standard-library checks.
status: Proved by CLOSED-H1-20261025-001A-P001: an independent code path (same session, V1) confirms BOUNDED-H1-20261025-001A. Rebuilt alternating diagrams alternate, have 1 + dim B components and determinant equal to the tree count; brute-force S4 transposition colourings equal the bicycle law and the twelve-state sum on 16 tripled graphs, the Potts(12,1/2) identity on 6 subdivided graphs, and the gadget prediction on 4 gadget knots (up to 1,158,510 colourings); odd gadget powers keep knots; interpolation recovers P(H,12) for K4, C5 and the diamond; a line-by-line audit of the written proof finds no gap.
title: Independent replay of the S4 knot hardness
